egas.name: Competent professional
egas.text: Competent professional: applies the knowledge and skills of the discipline with excellence.

egas.name: Creative problem solver
egas.text: Creative problem solver: designs and evaluates solutions to real problems.

egas.name: Socially responsible person
egas.text: Socially responsible person of faith and values: acts ethically for the common good.

pos.text: Apply knowledge of computing fundamentals appropriate to the discipline.
Analyze complex computing problems and identify the requirements appropriate to their solution.
Design, implement and evaluate computer-based solutions that meet given requirements.
Act ethically and responsibly in professional computing practice, with respect for privacy and the common good.
